Subject: Trouble accepting supplier invite — 'Session invalid' error

Hi Diego / Laura,

I tried to accept the supplier portal invite you sent this morning for Acme Parts Co., but when I click the link I immediately get a modal that says 'Session invalid — timestamp mismatch' and the login page reloads. I tried on both Chrome (Mac) and Safari, and an incognito window — same result.

I attached a screenshot of the error and pasted the invite link at the bottom of this message. Can you confirm whether the invite token expired or if there's something on our side to fix (time sync, cookies)? We need to register our bank details so the PO flow can start — this is blocking our first shipment.

Attachments: screenshot-error-20270409.png
Invite link: https://portal.zipsupply.example/invite/abc123

Thanks — please escalate if needed.

Hi Anna — thanks for the quick note and the screenshot. Sorry for the hiccup. A few quick items to try while I investigate:

- Can you confirm your machine time is set to automatic/network time (System Preferences → Date & Time)? If your device clock is out of sync it can break token validation.
- Try clearing cookies for the portal domain or open the invite in a private/incognito window (I know you tried, but sometimes leftover cookies + SSO redirect can interfere).
- If you have corporate SSO (Okta/Azure AD), can you try accepting the invite from a personal hotspot or home network to rule out a network proxy stripping headers?

I'm reissuing a fresh invite with a new token and longer TTL now — attaching the new invite link as a file in case the inline link gets clipped by your mail client. If the problem persists after those steps, please reply and I'll escalate to the provisioning team for logs.

New invite attached: zip-invite-link-20270409.txt

— Diego
Diego Fernandez
Vendor Onboarding Manager, Redwood Inference
diego_fernandez@redwood.ai

Date: Fri, 09 Apr 2027 17:30:05 -0700

Thanks Diego — I tried the new link and the same behavior occurred. I verified system time (macOS shows network time and matches time.google.com), tried with cookies cleared and on a phone hotspot. Still getting the same 'timestamp mismatch' message.

I've attached an additional screenshot and a short HAR capture on request (can provide privately). We do use Okta for SSO; when I accept the invite it briefly flashes the Okta redirect and then comes back to the portal with the error. Hypothesis: something in the SAML assertion/time window or a time drift between your front-end proxy and the auth service.

Can you share whether Redwood supports a SAML-proxy fallback or if we should accept a non-SSO invite (we'd prefer SSO). If you need our IdP metadata, I can send it.

Anna

Attachment: screenshot-error-20270409-2.png
From: diego_fernandez@redwood.ai <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>

Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 10 Apr 2027 08:10:44 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Vendor can't accept invite — possible SAML / token TTL issue

Neha — forwarding the thread with Acme Parts. Anna reports an immediate 'timestamp mismatch' after the Okta redirect. Steps I've taken: reissued invite with longer TTL, asked vendor to clear cookies and try different networks. They still hit the error.

Initial thoughts: either (A) our invite token validation window is too tight (tokens TTL measured at front edge vs IdP time skew), or (B) there's a clock skew between our proxy (edge-cache) and the auth server that validates SAML assertions.

Could you please:
- Check the portal provisioning logs for invite token validation around 2027-04-09T23:00Z for the invite id abc123. Look for gateway vs auth server timestamps and any UTC offset differences.
- If possible, temporarily extend the token TTL for this vendor and resend via the console.
- If SAML assertion validation errors appear, confirm if we have configured 'allowable skew' and whether it needs to be widened for affected regions.

Related console link: https://console.redwood.ai/portal/invite/abc123
HubSpot ticket: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/company/78910

If you want me to loop infra, I can. This is blocking Acme's ability to receive their first PO.

— Diego
From: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: diego_fernandez@redwood.ai
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, Anna Rivera <anna.rivera@acmeparts.com>
Date: Sat, 10 Apr 2027 09:45:37 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Vendor can't accept invite — possible SAML / token TTL issue

Quick update: I checked the provisioning logs and saw repeated token validation failures from the invite id abc123 between 2027-04-09T22:55:00Z and 2027-04-09T23:05:00Z. The gateway timestamp and the auth-service timestamp differed by ~120 seconds in a small set of requests (edge servers in us-west had an NTP drift after a maintenance window).

What I did: extended the invite TTL for Acme by 1 hour, reissued the invite (resend-invite-log-20270410.txt attached), and cleared the cached session tokens on the affected edge nodes. I also temporarily widened allowable clock skew for SAML assertions for the portal in the us-west edge pool.

Anna — can you try the new invite now?

Resolution note: the vendor clicked the new invite and completed onboarding (bank details uploaded) — they confirmed by phone. I've left the skew widened for 24 hours while we monitor and am opening an infra maintenance ticket to re-sync the affected nodes' NTP.

Neha Kapoor
Senior Site Reliability Engineer
Redwood Inference
